weakness: Shared Counter login; no account procedure, approvals, reviews, or leaver process; former technician's SYS-01 account active 9 months after departure

remediation_plan: Named counter accounts with MFA; joiner and leaver checklist; monthly reconciliation reviewed by the Owner
milestones: 2026-08-11 former technician account disabled; 2026-09-30 named counter accounts and checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation
resources_required: SYS-01 seats for 2 more named users (about $30 a month); Shop Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Technicians hold export rights; shared bench administrator account; no customer device access rule
remediation_plan: Technician role without export rights; named standard bench accounts with a separate admin account; customer device access standard (POL-04 4.4) with repair test checklists
milestones: 2026-09-15 SYS-01 roles changed; 2026-10-31 test checklists in use; 2026-12-31 named bench accounts (with POAM-006)

weakness: Backup console and firewall management login accept a password alone; bench storage console used the default administrator account with the password on a label
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on both and sends screenshots; named MSP accounts; bench storage default account disabled, named admin with MFA, label removed, console limited to the bench network
milestones: 2026-08-12 label removed and password changed; 2026-09-15 bench storage named admin and MFA; 2026-09-30 MSP MFA evidence received

weakness: No review of SYS-01 audit records or suite alerts
source: P07 (AU-06 objectives); P01 R-001, R-002; P03 G-077
remediation_plan: Turn on SYS-01 export alerts; monthly 20-minute review checklist (exports, bulk views, after-hours sign-ins); findings to the Owner

weakness: No contingency plan test; backup never restore-tested

weakness: Backups not immutable; one MSP login can delete them

weakness: No reporting rule; staff do not know whom to tell
